answer: Because the timing is entered against the vault challenge, the vertex audit can replay the sonnet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 213 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 841 identities would post 2478 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
